audit.why: Content layer already calls levels 1-3 even (skill trade on hook dodge) matching the packet levelChart and content win[0-2]="Skill".
Level 6 (Soul Shackles online) and first item (poke punishes whiffed Q) are the stated spikes and match spikes[] array.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-2].side on the full layer say "Morgana" (favoured 7-8/10) for Levels 1-3, but the SAME rows in the content layer (win[0-2]) already say "Skill", matching the packet levelChart exactly. The full-layer prose for those rows also describes Morgana out-poking Thresh from level 1, contradicting the mirrored/packet-backed even read.
audit.why: Neither Q (Dark Binding, 10s CD, 1250 range) nor his hook (Death Sentence, 19-9s CD, 1075 range) has a clear range/CD edge before level 4 when Black Shield comes online to hard-answer the hook-flay chain; the packet's win rate data (51.11% Thresh-favoured-ish, near-even) and the content whys[0-2] already describe this correctly as a skill matchup, not a Morgana favour.
audit.corrected: phases[0-2].side -> Skill, ratings normalized to 5/10, why text rewritten to describe the even hook-dodge trade instead of a false early Morgana favour.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Morgana's W/R grounding "shuts off Thresh's Dark Passage (W)", implying grounding Thresh prevents allies from using his dropped lantern to dash to him.
audit.why: Grounding effects deny dashes performed by the grounded unit itself. Thresh's W lantern-dash is performed by the ALLY clicking the lantern, not by Thresh — it is unclear from the kit text whether grounding Thresh also disables an ally's click-dash to an already-thrown lantern. This is not confirmed by Riot's ability text and risks being wrong if stated as fact.
audit.corrected: Left unwritten; recorded in notes instead of asserted as fact.
